summary.title: SmartHomes_ThreatModel_221410617
summary.description: SmartHomes Co. is a Saudi-based IoT smart home system that connects multiple devices such as smart locks, CCTV cameras, motion sensors, smart meters, and HVAC systems through a cloud-based home management system. Users interact with the system via a mobile application and web dashboard. The system processes user commands, collects IoT telemetry data, and stores information in centralized databases. Communication occurs over Wi-Fi, Zigbee, and internet connections. This model identifies security threats across sensing devices, communication channels, APIs/computation, and databases using the STRIDE methodology.

threats.title: Unauthorized Access via Weak Authentication
threats.description: An attacker impersonates a legitimate homeowner by exploiting weak authentication mechanisms (e.g., weak passwords or lack of multi-factor authentication) and gains unauthorized access to the system to control smart devices. Ref: T1, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) and device-based authentication to verify user identity securely.

threats.title: Malicious Modification of IoT Data
threats.description: An attacker alters or injects malicious data into communication between smart devices and the home management system, affecting device behavior or system operations. Ref: T3, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Use cryptographic integrity checks and secure communication protocols to ensure data authenticity.

threats.title: System Unavailability Due to Resource Exhaustion
threats.description: An attacker floods the system or IoT devices with excessive requests, exhausting system resources and making the smart home system unavailable to legitimate users. Ref: T8, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Deploy intrusion detection systems and rate-limiting mechanisms to detect and prevent abnormal traffic.

threats.title: Unauthorized Privilege Escalation
threats.description: An attacker or insider exploits system vulnerabilities to gain higher access privileges, enabling full control over smart home devices and configurations. Ref: T28, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and enforce least privilege principles for all users.

threats.title: Sensitive Data Exposure via Weak APIs
threats.description: Weak API security exposes sensitive user information such as personal data or payment details to unauthorized users through insecure endpoints. Ref: T21, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Limit API data exposure, enforce authentication, and use strong encryption for all API communications.

threats.title: Lack of Audit Trail for User Actions
threats.description: Users or attackers may deny performing actions such as unlocking doors or changing system settings due to insufficient or missing logging and audit mechanisms.
threats.mitigation: Implement secure logging with timestamps and tamper-proof audit trails for all critical system activities.

threats.title: Exposure of Sensitive Device Data
threats.description: Sensitive data such as CCTV footage or device status information is exposed to unauthorized users due to weak encryption or poor access control mechanisms. Ref: T2, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Encrypt stored data and enforce strict access control policies to prevent unauthorized access.

threats.title: Replay of Captured Communication Messages
threats.description: An attacker captures legitimate communication messages between devices and replays them later to execute unauthorized actions without proper authentication. Ref: T11, Anwar et al. (2020)
threats.mitigation: Use timestamps, nonces, and secure communication protocols to prevent replay attacks.
